ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio of approximately 75% high-intensity (white) to 25% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the central lobes; low-intensity black pigmentation is mapped to the entire trailing edge boundary, the median notch region, and isolated circular points on the interior surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 52 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge boundary with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels relative to the mean edge curve.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edge displays a smooth convex curve; trailing edge follows a complex trajectory of concavity near the notch followed by distal convexity.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct circular low-intensity clusters (rosettes) positioned mid-laterally on the right lobe; one larger circular cluster on the upper-central left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of multiple parallel linear rake marks on the upper distal quadrant of the right lobe; multiple unaligned linear disruptions on the lower proximal quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks across both lobe surfaces; irregular indentations along the trailing edge suggesting minor tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Broad, low-intensity pigmentation 'stem' at the median notch tapering vertically downward toward the fluke base.
